species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 68°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 1–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 40 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 60 ft, so fish stay above it.
